Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.f7206_ratio_places (owner accepted: line 6 ratio to six decimal places, half-up). Form 7206 line 6, "Divide line 4 by line 5", gives no precision. Project $66,962.61 = $72,053.00 less $10,440.21 x 0.487575 = $5,090.39 with line 6 = 0.512425 for biz_b (75,725.33 / 147,778.33) or 0.487575 for biz_a; the model multiplied by the exact fraction, model $66,962.62 (SE share $5,090.38). The recorded alternative reading (exact); one cent. Not evidence; dropped.

Ruling: model error; arithmetic. The model's own work for line 28 adds 24,296 + 5,282.90 + 20,572 + 5,159 + 28,708, which is 84,017.90 (the project's value), not 84,018.90; the $1.00 error carries into line 29, the home-office gross income limit, line 31, Form 7206 lines 4, 7, 8, 10 and 13 and the business's QBI. Each project value follows from 84,017.90 (line 29: 195,773.00 - 84,017.90 = 111,755.10).
